environmentVariables.name: ZAMMAD_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the ZAMMAD_API_TOKEN credential for the Zammad MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: ZAMMAD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Explicit full API base, e.g. https://support.example.com/api/v1. Overrides the instance URL above. Leave blank unless your instance serves the API somewhere non-standard.

environmentVariables.name: ZAMMAD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Root URL of your Zammad instance, e.g. https://support.example.com. The CLI appends /api/v1 itself. Without it the CLI points at a placeholder host that is not your instance.
